label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_01a
text: The weather’s in your favor today. I guess the\nsnowy mountains decided to be kind.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_01b
text: Well, tough luck for you. The snowy mountains\nare on my side today.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_02
text: These League-mandated inspections happen\na few times a year.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_03
text: If we don’t show we’re up for the job, we’ll lose\nour positions as Gym Leaders.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_04
text: Geeta always says it’s just a formality, but...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_05
text: I’ve already had to give up on being a pro\nsnowboarder. If she takes away the talents\r\nI still have to show, then what’ll be left?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_06
text: Sorry, didn’t mean to bring the temperature\ndown. It’s simple enough, really.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_07
text: All I need to do is make sure the power of my\nPokémon chills you to the bone![VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_08
text: Man, Geeta must really have it out for me.\nSending someone there’s no way I could beat...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_09
text: Still, no regrets on my part. I gave it everything\nI had.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_10
text: I hit you full force, and I lost anyway. It made me\nfeel...frustrated.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_11
text: It makes me want to become stronger as a Gym\nLeader. Put more of myself into it.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_12
text: I’d thought my passion had frozen over, but...\nyou’ve rekindled it for me.\c\nThanks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_13
text: I won’t lose next time. You’ll see.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: common_2020_koori_020_koori_14
text: Try not to catch a cold on your way down\nthe mountain, eh?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
